0022600237.text: The 11-2 Los Angeles Lakers, first in the Pacific and the West, visit the 4-6 Phoenix Suns, who are 11th in the West, with the Lakers riding a seven-game winning streak and an 8-2 record over their last ten. Los Angeles is missing Austin Reaves, Collin Sexton, Luka Doncic and Quentin Grimes, all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams, who is out after shoulder surgery. The Lakers won their last meeting 101-73 in Los Angeles on April 10, 2026, after losing the 2025-26 season series 2-3.
